From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Novatia discovery — recommended models, benchlinks, and regression guardrails
Attachments: redwood_latency_report_20260929.pdf, prompt-set-novatia-v1.jsonl

Hi Bethany — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the items I promised:

Call highlights:
- Primary goal: reduce customer support handle time by surfacing precise KB excerpts and suggested actions (hybrid retrieval + generation).
- Target latency SLO: 200ms tail for UI interactions (p95 target), throughput estimate ~150 TPS for peak flows.
- Quality concern: hallucination risk on escalation responses; we discussed conservative decoding + retrieval grounding.

Redwood recommendations (shortlist) — tuned for Novatia workload:
1) rwd-13b-q4f16 (Redwood-verified) — good balance of quality and cost; baseline p50: 18ms/token, p95: 115ms, p99: 190ms at 2048 context (see perf report).
2) rwd-7b-int8 (Redwood-verified) — lower cost option with similar throughput; p95: 85ms, p99: 160ms.
3) rwd-3b-opt (quantized) — latency-friendly for embedding+rerank paths; p95: 42ms.

Why these: the 13B variant gives the best pass-rate on your accuracy probe set we ran during the call (recall on KB retrieval + safe-answer rate). The 7B-int8 is a solid cost/latency tradeoff for bursty traffic.

Benchlinks and proof artifacts:
- Full perf snapshot & percentile table (attached): redwood_latency_report_20260929.pdf
- Prompt set we used for the recall/regression checks: prompt-set-novatia-v1.jsonl (attached)
- Drive folder with traces and sample responses: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-Example

Suggested next steps:
- Pilot scope: 2-week technical pilot (preprod) with the 7B-int8 + retrieval pipeline, sampling 10k interactive queries/day. Monica can lead implementation.
- Deliverables from us: pilot config, baseline perf (TPS/p50/p95/p99), prompt set, and weekly quality digest.
- Procurement ask: preferred contract/PO timeline so Rishi can draft pricing & pilot credits.

Let me know if you want the perf snapshot broken out by region (we can provide us/eu). If this looks good I’ll loop in Monica and send a short pilot plan doc + HubSpot record link.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Grant

Hi Michael — thanks for the thorough recap and the artifacts. This is exactly what we needed to evaluate internally. A few quick clarifications: 

- For the 7B-int8 option, can you confirm the p99 figure at our expected median prompt length (~1200 tokens total turn)? We need the tail number for the UI SLO discussion.
- We’ll want to lock down the evaluation dataset you used (the prompt-set-novatia-v1.jsonl) — will the Drive folder include the sampling harness and scoring script?
- Procurement: we typically go through an internal vendor review that takes 2–3 weeks; procurement@novatia.com is on loop and will reach out with their template.

We’re excited to run a short pilot. Can you include a suggested acceptance criteria list (quality pass/fail thresholds) and the expected cost for a 2-week pilot (estimate)? Also, SOC 2 evidence for security/compliance is required for our procurement team.

Best,
Bethany Collins
Head of Product, Novatia
bethany@novatia.com

Michael — thanks for the ping. Quick notes / commitments from my side: 

- Contract & procurement: We can offer a 2-week pilot agreement with a standard pilot SOW and a pilot credit (we typically discount pilot fees by up to 15% for new mid-market accounts). I’ll prepare a simple SOW + DocuSign link once Rishi shares the pricing.
- SOC 2 & compliance artifacts: I’ve attached the external SOC 2 summary and a link to our compliance package. We can provide an NDA or data processing addendum if Novatia requires it.
- Acceptance criteria (suggested):

  * Safety: < 1% unsafe/hallucinated responses in sampled production-like queries
  * Latency: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 220ms for the pilot workload (region: us-east)

- Action items: Monica to produce the MAP with milestones and sampling plan; Rishi to send pilot pricing (line items: infra cost + support + optional extra seats). I’ll prep the SOW/DocuSign template and push to HubSpot once pricing is ready.
